findings.where: shiploop_test_loop.py:609 and :917 (ids-missing / 'did not show a usable test run'); shiploop_test_counts.py:199-214 (_id_pattern, whole-token match); RC events 384, 410 (refusals), 415-422 (engine source reads), 429 (fix), 437 (accepted); RC/.shiploop-runs/work-*/run/tests/nav-8bd5884c4a0f468c8734a487c3cc7851-verify1.md and -verify2.md (status ids-missing)
findings.evidence: Checkers test-author: tests were titled TC-4a..TC-11c while the step plan declared ids TC-4, TC-6..TC-11. ShipLoop refused twice. Line 1: 'ShipLoop navigator: ShipLoop test run: test-author is not done. ShipLoop ran the 2 listed commands from <78-char path> and 2 did not show a usable test run:' (no remedy). The bullet says '-> did not show TC-4, TC-6... running (node reported 23 run, 23 failed). Make the command select those cases and print test names (for example --verbose).' That hint was wrong: node already printed '✖ TC-4a initial position...' (event 402, run with --test-reporter=spec); the real rule is that an id must appear as its own token (regex `(?<![\w-])TC-4(?![\w])`), so 'TC-4a' does not show 'TC-4'. Cost: 9 calls (#76-#84), 50.1 s from first refusal (event 384) to acceptance (437), 4 calls reading engine source (shiploop_test_loop.py:520-575, shiploop_test_counts.py:203-214) = the model learning the rule from code (S-4/S-5), a stack trace under the bullet, then renaming to 'TC-4 (a)'. The model recorded 'ShipLoop matches ids as whole tokens' in the durable test-strategy note (event ~540), so the packet-side rule was learned only by reading source. BS had no such refusal (ids TC-1..TC-8 whole).
findings.generic_fix: When a declared id is absent but a longer token containing it is present in the output (any id scheme), the refusal names that line and states the rule: the id must appear as its own word, e.g. `TC-4a` does not show `TC-4`; put that remedy on the refusal's first line and drop the misleading --verbose hint. For: F1 principle, S-4/S-5, one message in one function; against: none beyond wording tests. Generic: no id scheme or app text.

README); integration-verify met-S (DW1) / M (DW2); carry-forward met-F + S (Improve-triggered rerun, tests/nav-d590f972…-verify1.md); system-test-author met-F+SG; system-test met-S; product-acceptance met-F (model-run Chrome) + SG (unverified shape); release-plan partly-F (rollback not the printed recipe); release-check met-F (model-run, no record); release met-S (RD/return-receipt.md); release-verify met-S (observed.where=returned-result) + F (model-run in returned checkout); operations met-M; handoff met-S (receipt) + M.
